channel.title: The Nevada Independent - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Nevada Independent (thenevadaindependent.com)

item.title: ‘One of the most difficult decisions’: Nevada’s higher ed leaders lament tuition increase
item.description: Nevada's Board of Regents voted Friday to approve tuition increases which higher education leaders said were needed to fill an almost $50 million annual budget gap.

item.title: Escuelas chárter: ¿Qué son y cómo se comparan con los distritos escolares tradicionales?
item.description: Las escuelas chárter son otra opción de educación pública en Nevada, gratuita y abierta a todos los estudiantes. Esto es lo que usted debe saber antes de solicitar la inscripción.

item.title: Nevada Republican who negotiated bill that funds ICE says operation needs to ‘pivot’
item.description: Rep. Mark Amodei criticized Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem’s response after Border Patrol killed Alex Pretti over the weekend.

item.title: OPINION: Defunding ICE and impeaching Noem is a good first step
item.description: The right to bear arms, of course, is not the first right to be violated by the Trump administration in Minnesota, nor will it likely be the last.

item.title: Nevada health insurance marketplace enrollment dips nearly 6% but ‘remained fairly steady’
item.description: Amid fears that rising costs would discourage enrollment, Nevada’s new public option plans draw interest from those seeking lower-priced policies.

item.title: Republicano de Nevada que negoció proyecto que financia a ICE dice que la operación necesita un ‘cambio de estrategia’
item.description: El Congresista Mark Amodei criticó la respuesta de la secretaria de Seguridad Nacional luego de que la Patrulla Fronteriza mató a Alex Pretti el fin de semana.

item.title: Comunidad, dividida acerca de cambios en horario de inicio de clases en escuelas del Condado Clark
item.description: Mientras que algunos padres de familia y personal elogian al distrito por el cambio, otros se preocupan por las interrupciones en las actividades extraescolares de los estudiantes y la carga que podría suponer para los padres que trabajan.

item.title: Nevada will pay $19M more for SNAP this year. It’s taking steps to avoid further costs.
item.description: New federal rules are requiring states to pay more of SNAP's administrative costs, provide food assistance to fewer residents and curb erroneous payments.

item.title: One Vegas casino's plan to win back Canadians: a favorable currency exchange rate
item.description: Will Trump’s latest tirade against our northern neighbor put a crimp in efforts to boost downtown visitation? Also, Bally’s offers a Vegas project timeline.

item.title: Lombardo’s office declines lawmaker’s request to attend meeting on Musk’s Boring Co.
item.description: In a rare move, the governor’s office has declined an invitation from the chair of the state’s Interim Committee on Growth and Infrastructure to provide more details about the regulation of Elon Musk’s controversial Boring Company project in Southern Nevada.
